notes.title: 12/18 Update
notes.notes:
12/18 Update

Hi everybody!
I've been working on quite a few things and getting ready for the Holidays. I hope you are all enjoying your Holiday season.
I added quite a bit in this update, but I still have a lot more coming. As always I appreciate your continued interest and support. I'm working on getting new screenshots and game play trailers made. Anything you want to post on the community page would be helpful. Here's a list of most of the things that I added in this update...

   Goblins
    Werewolves
    Rotating Camera (q and e keys)
    Destructible and Repairable fences (Left click on knocked over fences when near to repair)
     Tweaks to game play (damage indicators and knock back, animations, and debugging) 


As always there's a lot more to come and I'm working to get a lot ready for the Holiday break. Thanks again!

-Chris

notes.title: 11/2 Update
notes.notes:
Hi I'm Chris,

I just wanted to say thank you to everyone who purchased the game and let you know that I really appreciate it. As this is my first game it really means a lot.

I've updated the game so that when your character gets hurt he gets sent to the shed. It's a delay feature while the monsters attack your house. The house dies, your character won't. 

I also increased house health, hero health, and the big zombie health. I adjusted speeds to reflect the more lumbering nature of the hordes that are to come. 

I also added different sword animations for cleaner strikes. 

I'm still working daily and again, I really appreciate your support. Thank you so much.
